verdict.rationale: Goodwin's own pages list "New company formation" as a service within its technology and emerging-company practice. Its Founders Workbench Document Driver generates formation documents for a Delaware corporation or LLC, which shows formation is a documented part of the startup offering. The evidence does not name the specific deliverables or describe formation as an engaged-counsel service. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of charter/certificate of incorporation, bylaws, initial board consents and founder stock purchase agreements; a dedicated description of the incorporation engagement; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can engage the firm to incorporate my company — charter, bylaws, initial board consents, and founder stock purchase — documented as a core of its startup/emerging-companies practice

citations.quote: providing dedicated representation to over 1,200 emerging companies and entrepreneurs
Our Document Driver® enables you to generate documents to form either a Delaware corporation or LLC.
